# FavTutor

> > FavTutor connects students with expert tutors for live 1-on-1 coding help, interview prep, and AI-powered development tools across multiple programming languages.

FavTutor is a comprehensive platform offering both live tutoring sessions with experienced programmers and free AI-powered coding tools. The platform specializes in computer science education, technical interview preparation, and hands-on programming assistance across Python, Java, C++, SQL, and machine learning.

- Homework Assistance

## Programming Language Tutors

- [Top Online Python Tutors](https://favtutor.com/python-tutors): Connect with top Python tutors for 1-on-1 lessons covering Flask, Django, and Python skills.
- [Top Java Tutors Online](https://favtutor.com/java-programming-tutors): Find expert Java tutors for private 1-on-1 sessions with 24x7 support available.
- [Top R Tutors Online](https://favtutor.com/r-tutor): Find qualified R programming and R Studio tutors for live 1-on-1 tutoring sessions.
- [Top SQL Tutors Online](https://favtutor.com/sql-tutors): Connect with SQL tutors for 1-on-1 database training in MySQL, Oracle, and SQL fundamentals.

## Specialized Technical Tutoring

- [Data Structures & Algorithms Tutors](https://favtutor.com/data-structures-tutors): Get live tutoring in DSA, arrays, queues from expert data structures and algorithms tutors.
- [Machine Learning Tutors Online](https://favtutor.com/machine-learning-tutor): Get 1-on-1 machine learning and AI tutoring covering neural networks and reinforcement learning.
- [LeetCode Tutors for Interview Prep](https://favtutor.com/leetcode-tutors): Get LeetCode help and tech interview prep from tutors at Google, Amazon, Facebook.

- [AI Code Generator](https://favtutor.com/ai-code-generator): AI-powered code generator tool for writing complete programs in any programming language.
